transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Frank's defining architecture is a persistent operational-closure spine, not recurrence count: admitted state shapes action; action changes/queries world; verified outcome is causally bound; credit admits state change; provenance-valid re-entry changes the next cycle. A simpler implementation may compress organs only if this causal closure and its historical function signatures survive.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: A smaller closed-loop controller can preserve the closure signatures, implying current internal structure can be simplified without reducing Frank to an open workflow.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Progressive architecture compression under frozen episodes: retain exact world/action/outcome/credit/re-entry and slow goal state, fuse/remove one internal mechanism at a time, then compare causal signatures, restart continuity, correction under perturbation, OOD and resources.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Recurrence belongs where temporal closure needs it. Model-local automatic/native-workspace computation may remain feed-forward or shallow; deliberative recurrence is adaptive; world-causal closure recurs across action/outcome; slow homeostatic/goal closure recurs across sessions/restarts.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: A single recurrence regime is sufficient and easier to tune.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Separate automatic, complex deliberative, tool/world and cross-session tasks; lesion recurrence independently at each ring and measure which functions fail.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: A loop is not semantically closed because IDs and outcomes match; exact consumers must validate producer/object/state/frontier/authority binding before consequential re-entry or learning.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Producer-signed receipts and current epoch checks are sufficient.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched same-outcome GWT splice, sibling state, stale artifact and reward-prefix faults; require invalid closure to fail before REENTERED/DONE/learning.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Continue/halt/restart/branch selection should combine unresolved pressure, estimated correction-vs-introduction dynamics, marginal verified utility, diversity and resource/instability cost.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: A fixed shallow retry/restart policy is more robust OOD.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Fixed-1 vs fixed-K vs adaptive on matched seeds with thinking-trap injection, truthful/shuffled/no-reentry and cost shadows.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Current execution state should be represented by an active lineage/path while failed/exploratory branches remain quarantined but reusable as noncurrent alternatives; Hyperposition may share this branch substrate without making it semantic truth.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Linear checkpoints plus set-valued alternatives are sufficient.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Long-horizon repair and rollback workloads comparing branch tree vs linear snapshots on success, context, false branch revival, storage and recovery.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: UnifiedDB should distinguish immutable observation episode, effective/valid interval, transaction/admission lineage and current adjudicated belief, preventing ghost/stale memory without deleting history.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Epochs plus provenance/current flags already provide sufficient temporal semantics.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Conflict-heavy temporal benchmark + write-time concurrency faults; compare stale errors, historical accuracy, abstention, write amplification and latency.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayGraph/Hyperposition higher-order relations and emergently distributed organs require an irreducibility gate: first fit/test pairwise/factorized explanations; promote higher-order only when interventions show residual synergistic causal utility.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Higher-order structure is a useful native representation even when reducible.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Pairwise projection vs order-3/4 representation with lesions and PEID/PID-style synergy; measure incremental outcome and complexity.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayCode should be maximally explicit at identity/state/provenance/effect/re-entry boundaries, executable-differential tested, and aggressively compiled/lowered internally without allowing host semantics to become authority.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Uniform full-language runtime typing is simpler and safer.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Mutation/fuzz + differential semantics across evaluator and lowerings; compare false acceptance, compile/runtime cost and OOD generated-code validity.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Material reward is a projection over independently verified outcome+credit lineage, not an endogenous activity score; deterministic folds are favored if exact authoritative frontier/currentness is proven.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Transactional mutable reward state with exactly-once consumption is simpler and equally safe.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Concurrent DONE, ACK loss, source rollback/replacement, delayed credit and self-reward laundering matrix.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: LCOP/native workspace is an optional measured evidence plane. It can influence control only after observability, intervention/actionability and incremental outcome-value gates, scoped to exact model/build/basis.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: System receipts + LoopDynamicsReadout already dominate after cost; LCOP should remain research-only.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Queued dual-workspace factorial + observability/actionability/outcome triad + pre/post-binary transfer.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Consequential projections should bind source semantic root/head plus compact StateWitness/SelectionWitness and be revalidated at use; hierarchical commitments can make this affordable.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: Transactions plus ordinary query provenance are enough.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Sibling-state, same-epoch divergence, projection rebuild and stale-selection faults under full-root vs hierarchical witness schemes.

transformed_hypotheses.hypothesis: Frank start/resume is conjunctive across trusted executable subject, storage runtime capability, selected semantic lineage, identity, lease/execution generation, stream replay state and recovery compatibility; explicit validated migration may replace exact equality, but no unrelated green gate substitutes.
transformed_hypotheses.counter: A smaller cryptographic/state root can imply enough subchecks to collapse gates.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Build subject swap, PATH/import shadow, SQLite object substitution, sibling state, stale lease, replay-gap and restart matrix; derive only proven logical gate implications.

architecture_hypothesis.name: FRANK MOC-KERNEL — Multiscale Operational Closure Kernel
architecture_hypothesis.core_claim: The smallest coherent Frank v0.1 should be one executable ClayCode loop-core whose defining property is nested operational closure across multiple timescales. Higher-order value comes from the architecture of causal closure, not from maximizing recurrence depth or adding more cognitive layers.

rings.role: automatic processing plus optional NativeModelWorkspace/LCOP evidence
rings.recurrence: NOT_REQUIRED_BY_ARCHITECTURE; may be model-internal if the chosen model has it

rings.role: self/world/memory bounded assembly, Hyperposition alternatives, control pressures, ClayGWT competition, prospection, Needle routing, adaptive halt/restart/reseed
rings.authority: selection/routing only; no effect authority minting

rings.role: intent/effect gate, action, observed outcome, causal credit, admission, consume-bound provenance, provenance-valid re-entry
rings.authority: deterministic effect boundary remains externalized inside module as typed gate

rings.role: goals, reward/control successor, regulatory personality, memory consolidation, capability self-model, anti-stagnation/homeostasis, checkpoint/recovery continuity
rings.authority: slow state updates require admitted evidence; self-generated activity cannot mint material reward

shared_spine: UnifiedDB authoritative semantic state with execution-vs-semantic memory separation
immutable episode lineage plus current adjudicated belief and candidate bitemporal validity
selected semantic continuation head and state/materialization distinction
StateWitness + SelectionWitness + consume-bound verification for consequential use
Hyperposition branch/equivalence fabric pairwise-first with irreducibility gate
single presence lease_epoch for authority fencing; separate stream/event sequence for delivery replay
CognitiveCycleShadow + LoopDynamicsReadout + resource shadow; no scalar emergence score
BinaryFreezeCandidate selects robust operating region, not transient peak
architectural_nonclaims: Does not claim consciousness or phenomenology.
Does not require every subsystem/workspace to be recurrent.
Does not claim recurrence count itself is higher-value.
Does not promote LCOP/native workspace to loop owner.
Does not make ClayGraph, latent activation, GWT salience or reward score an authority source.
Does not authorize self.root to mutate its own Harness.
architecture_hypothesis.strongest_counterhypothesis: Operational closure is necessary but the four-ring realization is overfactored. A materially smaller one-module closed-loop controller may preserve all required causal/restart/goal/re-entry signatures at lower complexity. This is the correct compression counterhypothesis; an open durable workflow is not treated as architecture-equivalent.
falsification_program: Build the smallest reference MOC slice around real Frank episodes without changing canonical architecture.
Lesion R1 recurrence while preserving R2/R3 closure; test automatic vs complex vs tool/world vs cross-session tasks.
Lesion R2 provenance-bound re-entry while holding visible outcomes equal; verify future state/learning diverges or invalid closure is blocked.
Lesion R3 persistent goal/reward state across restart while replaying identical current prompt; test long-horizon continuation/coherence.
Progressively compress/fuse R1 regulators and historical organs; retain only mechanisms whose lesion/rescue or resource-adjusted outcome signature is nonredundant.
Compare branch DAG vs linear checkpoint and bitemporal vs epoch-only state under controlled memory conflicts.
Run dual-workspace factorial; keep R0 LCOP optional if it adds no incremental value.
Sweep recurrence/gain/damping/re-entry depth to identify robust operating region and instability boundaries.
Only after matched Ubuntu/VPS replay and recovery evidence may an MOC realization become a binary-freeze candidate.
architecture_hypothesis.prediction: If MOC is substantially correct, systems that match Frank on isolated prompt→answer benchmarks but break R2 or R3 closure will diverge on interrupted, state-changing, multi-session, error-recovery and self-correction trajectories even when the underlying model is held fixed. The effect need not collapse to one scalar; it should appear as a structured pattern across continuity, causal correctness, repair, state integrity and long-horizon regulation.
